title: 420Hz failure and recovery semantics
purpose: Define deterministic fail-closed failure, retry, partial-output, restart, reconciliation and recovery semantics without inventing live services or deployment state.
recoveryPrinciples: reconcile canonical/source authority before retrying any action that could create spend, entitlement, publication, vote, moderation or remedy effects
never infer terminal success from local UI state, worker prose, queue state, notification delivery or partial artifacts
retries are idempotent against the original logical operation unless the user explicitly creates a new authorized attempt
partial results remain non-final until the bound verification and acceptance policy says otherwise
derived projections are rebuildable and never used to override canonical source state during recovery
privacy classification survives failure and recovery; dependency failure never widens PRIVATE/UNLISTED state
recovery preserves immutable history and creates explicit superseding/correction records rather than silently rewriting finalized state
when safe reconciliation is impossible, remain degraded/read-only or fail closed rather than guessing authority

providerUnavailable: before submission, fail without creating provider entitlement or charge
after canonical submission but before acceptance, reconcile AI/Compute request/job state before rematch/retry
after acceptance/running, preserve the accepted provider/resource/economic bindings and follow canonical timeout/failure/dispute rules
provider outage does not authorize switching beneficiary, price, verification profile or privacy policy
timeout: client timeout is not proof the server/provider operation failed
on timeout, query/reconcile by canonical request/job/idempotency references before resubmission
if canonical state is still pending/running, resume observation rather than creating a new paid attempt
if canonical terminal state is confirmed, recovery follows that exact terminal state
cancellation: local cancel intent is not proof of canonical cancellation
cancel retry uses the same request/job identity and is idempotent
after cancellation request, reconcile final canonical job and economic state before showing refund/terminal claims
cancellation never implies PAYER_REFUND_PAID without canonical payment evidence
partialOutput: a partial mix/stem/manifest may be retained as PARTIAL_OUTPUT for user review only when the provider/result manifest identifies it distinctly
partial artifact presence does not imply SUCCEEDED, VERIFIED, REGISTERED, PUBLISHED or SETTLED
partial output cannot earn payment unless the accepted canonical policy explicitly supports partial payable units and verification
user may discard, keep private, or start a new authorized generation attempt; reuse of partial artifacts never bypasses rights/privacy/provenance rules
malformedOrMissingResult: do not advance to valid result/verified state
preserve job/result references and evidence for retry/dispute/refund handling
artifact hash/manifest mismatch is STORAGE_INTEGRITY_FAILURE or VERIFICATION_FAILURE and fails closed

retrySemantics: same logical mutation + same idempotency key + same material payload reconciles to the existing operation or safely retries the same transition
same idempotency key + changed material payload is CONFLICT/REPLAY and fails closed
new paid generation after a terminal failed/cancelled attempt requires a fresh intent/run and fresh authorization unless canonical recovery explicitly preserves the same funded entitlement
retry never duplicates provider entitlement, payer charge, publication, follow/favorite/playlist relation, chart credit, nomination candidate, vote, moderation action or Arbitration remedy
backoff/rate-limit behavior may delay retry but cannot alter canonical state
automatic retry is forbidden for actions requiring new user consent, a new price, changed rights scope, changed beneficiary, changed voter choice or changed moderation remedy

requiredReconciliationOrder: 1 verify configured chain/network and canonical service identities/versions
2 restore Wallet/session capability state without recovering private signing secrets into 420Hz
3 reconcile 420AI/Compute requests, accepted matches, running jobs, result commitments and verification state
4 reconcile payer funding, provider entitlement, refund/claimability and settlement state
5 restore Storage manifests/artifact integrity/deletion tombstones and project references
6 reconcile Creative/Rights publication, licenses, provenance and source authorization
7 restore 420Hz private project/draft metadata from durable application state
8 rebuild Community source relations and privacy state
9 rebuild Charts from eligible source signals/checkpoints
10 restore Awards season/category/nomination/ballot/vote/result history from canonical product-domain state
11 restore moderation/report/appeal/challenge state and optional Arbitration references
12 rebuild Indexer/Search/Analytics projections from canonical/qualified sources
13 resume Notifications delivery/replay from consumer-owned checkpoints
14 accept new privileged/money-moving work only after required reconciliations agree
rules: restart does not assume in-memory queue/UI state is complete
durable idempotency/replay keys must survive restart where they guard duplicate side effects
unfinished operations resume from canonical/durable checkpoints instead of being silently marked failed or successful
recovery order may skip non-applicable layers but may not move a lower-authority projection ahead of its owning source
operator recovery actions are bounded by the same authority rules as normal operation

storageRecovery: every recovered artifact is checked against its content/integrity commitment before use
deletion/tombstone state wins over stale replicas, backups, caches and projection rebuilds
missing artifact bytes with an existing manifest are reported unavailable and are not replaced with different bytes under the same identity
restored backups must reapply current privacy/retention/deletion state before becoming readable
partial or failed generation artifacts retain PRIVATE visibility unless an explicit later publication transition succeeds
economicRecovery: before any retry that could spend again, reconcile quote, actual funded credit, accepted price, payer maximum, provider beneficiary and existing entitlement
provider EARNED/CLAIMABLE/PAID and payer REFUNDABLE/CLAIMABLE/PAID remain distinct through recovery
timeout/provider failure cannot create a second charge or provider entitlement
settlement outage preserves verified entitlement without falsely marking PAID
refund outage preserves payer refund claimability without falsely marking REFUNDED/PAID
economic disagreement blocks new spending until canonical reconciliation succeeds
rightsPublicationRecovery: a Generate result is not publication authority and recovery never auto-registers/publishes it
Register/Publish retry rechecks Wallet authorization, canonical Creative/Rights source state, rights/consent, disclosure/provenance and idempotency
if registration succeeded but client response was lost, recovery resolves the existing native Creator/Work/Recording IDs instead of creating duplicates
if publication rights/consent are revoked or stale before publication completes, fail closed and preserve the unpublished project/result
moderation or Arbitration cannot rewrite Creative/Rights state during recovery
identityAwardsRecovery: Identity eligibility outage blocks unique-human Awards actions that require it but does not fabricate ineligibility or expose private proof data
vote retry uses the same ballot-scoped voter/nullifier replay domain and cannot create a second accepted vote
lost vote response is reconciled against Awards canonical vote state before retry
finalization recovery recomputes from the frozen ballot/policy/accepted-vote set and is single-use
finalized AwardResult history is never recalculated under a newer policy after restart
runoff/correction paths remain explicit new records rather than mutation of historical bytes
communityChartsRecovery: follow/favorite/playlist mutations reconcile by logical relation/idempotency key after timeout/restart
duplicate event replay cannot inflate Community counters or Chart credit
Chart snapshots are rebuilt from eligible source signals plus policy/window/checkpoint and must reproduce deterministic ordering for identical inputs
stale/reorged source inputs cause degraded/stale labeling or fail-closed behavior according to chart policy
Search/Analytics rebuild cannot create or resurrect Community/Chart source authority
moderationDisputeRecovery: report retry is idempotent and cannot duplicate enforcement
lost moderation response is reconciled against append-only report/decision/appeal state
moderator or reviewer capability is revalidated after restart before new enforcement
vote-abuse review recovery cannot hand-edit tallies; accepted/invalidated vote state drives deterministic retally
optional Arbitration recovery validates service/domain/origin/parties/finality/remedy/replay before any bounded 420Hz remedy is consumed
case opening or stale ruling observation never auto-executes a remedy

indexerSearch: Indexer/Search outage does not mutate canonical application/protocol state
on recovery, projections rebuild/reconcile from canonical source/checkpoints
wrong-chain, stale or reorged projections are rejected for privileged/security-sensitive decisions
public availability may degrade to direct canonical reads or unavailable/read-only state where supported
analytics: Analytics may lose/rebuild aggregates without affecting source truth
recovery never ingests protected private payloads merely to reconstruct metrics
notifications: delivery failure does not roll back source operations
consumer replay resumes from notification-owned opaque checkpoints
stable event/deduplication keys prevent duplicate delivery effects
deep links/actions after delivery still require normal authorization

degradedModes.mustNot: fabricate local generation success or bypass canonical compute

degradedModes.mode: project/artifact read/write unavailable for affected objects

degradedModes.mustNot: downgrade unique-human policy to Wallet-only silently

degradedModes.mode: new paid generation/settlement actions disabled as required

degradedModes.mustNot: become canonical or expose private data

operatorRecoveryRules: operators may pause ingestion, matching, generation submission, publication, voting or moderation surfaces when required to prevent unsafe duplicate/privileged effects
operator tools may inspect/reconcile identifiers and checkpoints but cannot fabricate canonical completion, settlement, rights, votes, winners or rulings
manual data repair that changes authoritative application state requires a versioned/auditable correction path defined by the owning domain
after incident recovery, service readiness requires dependency identity/version/freshness/integrity checks appropriate to the surface
queued work is resumed only after reconciliation determines it remains authorized and non-terminal
failureRules: client/network timeout cannot be interpreted as canonical failure or success without reconciliation
partial output cannot be presented as SUCCEEDED/VERIFIED/REGISTERED/PUBLISHED/SETTLED
retry before canonical reconciliation cannot create a second paid generation attempt
changed payload under an existing idempotency key fails closed
restart cannot discard durable replay/idempotency state for protected mutations
storage integrity mismatch or tombstoned object cannot be served during recovery
lost Register/Publish response cannot cause duplicate Creative IDs
Identity outage cannot silently weaken a unique-human voting policy
lost vote response cannot produce a second accepted vote
Chart rebuild with identical policy/input/checkpoint cannot produce nondeterministic ordering
moderation recovery cannot duplicate enforcement or erase appeal history
Indexer/Search/Analytics/Notifications recovery cannot override source authority
dependency failure cannot widen PRIVATE/UNLISTED visibility
operator recovery cannot fabricate canonical state
invariants: HZGCA-REC-001 timeout/transport failure is ambiguous until reconciled against canonical/durable state
HZGCA-REC-002 retries are idempotent and never duplicate charges, entitlements, publication, social state, chart credit, nominations, votes, moderation or remedies
HZGCA-REC-003 partial artifacts never imply verified completion, publication or settlement
HZGCA-REC-004 recovery reconciles higher-authority canonical sources before lower-authority projections
HZGCA-REC-005 restart preserves durable idempotency/replay protection for protected mutations
HZGCA-REC-006 provider failover/rematch cannot change frozen accepted economic/privacy/verification terms without a new authorized transition
HZGCA-REC-007 storage integrity and deletion tombstones survive restart/backup/projection recovery
HZGCA-REC-008 economic recovery preserves payer/provider amount/state separation and never fabricates PAID/REFUNDED
HZGCA-REC-009 Register/Publish recovery resolves existing canonical Creative IDs rather than duplicating successful registration
HZGCA-REC-010 Identity-dependent unique-human voting fails closed during eligibility uncertainty
HZGCA-REC-011 Awards vote/finalization recovery is replay-safe, deterministic and single-use
HZGCA-REC-012 Community/Charts recovery cannot inflate source relations or qualified chart credit
HZGCA-REC-013 moderation/report/appeal recovery remains append-only and authority-scoped
HZGCA-REC-014 Arbitration recovery validates exact domain/origin/finality/remedy/replay before bounded consumption
HZGCA-REC-015 derived-service recovery never overrides canonical source authority or privacy
HZGCA-REC-016 Notifications delivery recovery cannot roll back or mutate source operations
HZGCA-REC-017 degraded modes preserve safety by disabling/limiting affected features rather than guessing authority
HZGCA-REC-018 HZ-GCA-1.17 creates no live recovery daemon, deployment, endpoint, address, custody or new protocol authority
exitCriteria: provider failure, timeout, cancellation, malformed/missing result and partial-output semantics are explicit
restart reconciliation order and durable replay protection are explicit
storage, economics, rights/publication, Identity/Awards, Community/Charts, moderation/Arbitration and derived-service recovery are explicit
degraded modes and operator-safe recovery boundaries are explicit
failure/recovery invariants are executable in the targeted verifier
no runtime recovery service, address, endpoint, live provider behavior or testnet evidence is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.18 through HZ-GCA-1.20
